title: capsicum baccatum var. umbilicatum
intro: Capsicum baccatum var. umbilicatum, commonly known as the Yellow Raya pepper, is a variety of the baccatum pepper plant, which is native to the Andean region of South America. This plant is rich in various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in relieving pain, reducing fever, and aiding in digestion. The bioactive constituents of Capsicum baccatum var. umbilicatum include capsaicinoids, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The Yellow Raya pepper has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, and its bioactive constituents have been studied for their potential therapeutic actions in the treatment of certain diseases.
